## 1.0.0 (2026-10-30)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* say when the backup or sync folder is gone ([e170c24](https://github.com/jibon-k/notes-morphe-patches/commit/e170c242da6d657c9d285e6bdd321729bdcbeeaa))

### ✨ New Features

* back up and sync notes through a folder ([187fb6d](https://github.com/jibon-k/notes-morphe-patches/commit/187fb6db2d19847f1e4f4035d4ce51917d0603e3))
* credit link under the Backup row ([d71e72b](https://github.com/jibon-k/notes-morphe-patches/commit/d71e72bb027688794d7ef2717106d00b2d8969f4))
* hide Samsung account and cloud features ([1c99e89](https://github.com/jibon-k/notes-morphe-patches/commit/1c99e89339666a9e4dac4b2134522eff32020d8f))
* own app name, logo and accent colour ([efd17db](https://github.com/jibon-k/notes-morphe-patches/commit/efd17db457d04251c274b34cf1d97087b1ff39f8))
* pen button actions with learned buttons ([6c507f8](https://github.com/jibon-k/notes-morphe-patches/commit/6c507f809950a3cde5807d061fef0279dc1c9b93))
* pen support and finger drawing ([e1ee711](https://github.com/jibon-k/notes-morphe-patches/commit/e1ee71162e31b7a5a95e565ff8b757a5f2d7d79d))
* run Samsung Notes without One UI ([d7f033f](https://github.com/jibon-k/notes-morphe-patches/commit/d7f033fa93f58381bc1c599bfc7437245ba589ec))

patches.name: Backup to folder
patches.description: Adds a Backup row to the bottom of the side menu: backs up changed notes as .sdocx files to a folder you choose (any folder, including SD card or a synced folder).

patches.name: Branding
patches.description: Your own app name, the Notes pen logo as launcher icon, and an accent colour in place of Samsung's blue.

options.description: Name under the launcher icon. Empty: keep Samsung Notes.
#rrggbb for buttons, switches and highlights. Empty: keep Samsung's blue.
#rrggbb used in the dark theme; a lighter shade reads better on dark backgrounds. Empty: the light-theme colour.

patches.name: Crash fixes
patches.description: Reports no iris scanner, and finds the pen settings layouts and colour palettes after a package rename (otherwise the colour picker crashes).

patches.name: Finger drawing
patches.description: Turns off "S Pen only" by default (once, at first start), so fingers can draw and scroll. Without it, the app assumes an S Pen and ignores finger input in notes.

patches.name: Folder sync
patches.description: Experimental. Syncs notes with other devices through a shared folder (for example one kept in sync by Syncthing): "Sync now" in the Backup menu, and automatically each time the app opens.

patches.name: Hide Samsung account features
patches.description: Hides Samsung Cloud sync, sign-in prompts, sharing, Galaxy AI and note locking. They need a Samsung-signed app; this matters mostly on Samsung phones, where the account exists.

patches.name: Hide camera
patches.description: Removes Insert > Camera from the editor.

patches.name: Manifest compatibility
patches.description: Makes One UI-only libraries optional (otherwise the install fails), gives foreground services a type (Android 14+ crashes without one) and drops multiArch.

patches.name: Pen button actions
patches.description: Lets the pen's two buttons run actions (pen, eraser, undo, colour picker, page up/down...) with single, double and long press. Set up in Settings > Pen button actions. Works with pens whose buttons send key presses (the Redmi Smart Pen sends Page Up / Page Down).

options.description: Android key code the pen's upper button sends. Find it with `adb shell getevent -l` or a key tester app.
Android key code the pen's lower button sends.

Only keys from an input device whose name contains this count as pen buttons. @stylus: any device that reports itself as a stylus. Empty: any device (a keyboard's Page Up / Page Down would then run pen actions too). Buttons learned in the app (Settings > Pen button actions > Learn buttons) replace these options.

patches.name: Samsung framework compatibility
patches.description: Adds stand-ins for One UI framework classes and redirects calls to One UI-only methods and fields, so the app runs on non-Samsung Android.

patches.name: Treat as pen device
patches.description: Turns on the app's pen features (pen toolbar, hover) on a device with an active pen that isn't a Samsung S Pen. Leave it off on devices without an active pen.

patches.name: Turn off Samsung cloud components
patches.description: Turns off the Samsung account, cloud sync, push and co-editing services and receivers. They can't work in a patched app and would only run in the background.
